query:
// One row per receiver for the selected season and season type. Players traded
// mid-season have several team rows; they are summed and rates recomputed.
DEFINE
    VAR __Season = "2025"
    VAR __SeasonType = "REG"
    VAR __MinVolume = 50
    VAR __Grouped =
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            'Player Season Summary'[player_key],
            'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
            TREATAS ( { __Season }, 'Player Season Summary'[season] ),
            TREATAS ( { __SeasonType }, 'Player Season Summary'[season_type] ),
            "@Pos", MAX ( 'Player Season Summary'[position] ),
            "@Teams", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'Player Season Summary'[team_key] ), 'Player Season Summary'[team_key], "/" ),
            "@Tgt", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[targets] ),
            "@Rec", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[receptions] ),
            "@Yds", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[receiving_yards] ),
            "@YAC", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[yards_after_catch] ),
            "@EPA", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[receiving_epa] )
        )
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS (
    FILTER ( __Grouped, [@Tgt] >= __MinVolume ),
    "Player", 'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
    "Position", [@Pos],
    "Team", [@Teams],
    "Targets", [@Tgt],
    "Receptions", [@Rec],
    "CatchRate", DIVIDE ( [@Rec], [@Tgt] ),
    "Yards", [@Yds],
    "YACPerReception", DIVIDE ( [@YAC], [@Rec] ),
    "EPA", [@EPA],
    "EPAPerPlay", DIVIDE ( [@EPA], [@Tgt] )
)
ORDER BY [EPA] DESC
